The code should then draw a signal line and a ground line to create a bent signal wire and two bent ground wires respectively. It should also draw a dielectric to create a dielectric cable, and create bottom metals. 

Afterwards, the code should create port interfaces (PEC enclosures) and a Perfect E boundary condition. It should also create ports and a setup and sweep with specified properties. 

Finally, the code should plot the model and release AEDT.
